nodes.statement: In the initialization step (step~0) of this algorithm, some of the boldseta_j's will likely be set to zero. This suggests that the corresponding predictors do not appear related to the response. However, the initialization assumes a linear model. It is conceivable that a response that appears unimportant using a linear model will become statistically significant using a nonlinear model. Hence, if boldseta_j is estimated to be zero in step~0 we instead set boldseta _j equal to the loading vector of the first principal component of Theta_j. This estimate is the direction that explains the most variability in X_ij(t) so is the most natural unsupervised projection and allows for potential nonlinear relationships to be detected in step~2.
